text:
jamie: Afternoon — quick async check. Onboarded llama3-smallq to staging and ran the ES+EN promptset evals. Enabled KV warmup. Found weird Spanish tokenization regressions; some prompts split into extra tokens with a stray <|eoc|>-like marker. Will triage today and open a tokenizer fix PR.

anika: can you paste a failing example and the token list? will try a quick repro locally.

jamie: pasted below, short snippet — original prompt + model output and tokenized sequence:
```
input: "Resumen rápido: ¿Cómo funciona el enrutamiento?"
model output: "Resumen rÃ¡pido: ? Cómo funciona el enrutamiento"
tokens: [\"ĠResumen\", \"Ġrá\", \"pido\", \":\", \"Ġ\xe2\x80\x9d\", \"Ġ?\", \"ĠCómo\"]
```
looks like a utf8/normalization hiccup mixing with sentencepiece boundaries — yields extra tokens that break eval exact-match.

ryan: could be a mismatch between the tokenizer we used at compile time vs the one in the eval harness. did you run `scripts/harness --retokenize`? also check `spm_model.vocab_size` — i saw an off-by-one when we quantized the vocab.

jamie: ran `--retokenize` already, still see the stray bytes. suspect an encoding step in the onboard pipeline; will diff the preproc between model-bundle and eval harness.

ci-bot: CI: eval-run/1749991235 finished — 3 regressions, 1 new failing prompt (tags: spanish-tokenization).

anika: ok, if it's reproducible we should add a minimal unit test and block rollout until we confirm fix. i can pair on the tokenizer patch at 4pm PT. :thumbsup:

ops: i have a 4pm slot open for pairing, adding a calendar invite with video.

jamie: thanks — i'll open a draft PR with the failing example and the harness command used, link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/assorted/pull/xxxx (draft). Will run a quick smoke after token fix and flip staging back to canary if green.

ryan: FYI — if we need a faster mitigation, we can add a temporary post-tokenizer normalize step `unicodedata.normalize('NFC', s)` in the eval path and re-run rollout. not ideal but quick.

jamie: noted. will try normalize fallback first, then proper fix in tokenizer lib. will post results here after 4pm pairing.

anika: awesome. thanks for the quick heads-up.

jamie: cc @ops for the invite, and thanks @ci-bot for the eval run data.
